disposition_reason: Table 1 prints zinc and iron means for eight canned sardine brands and reports copper, nickel, lead, cadmium, manganese and chromium below detection.

study.design: market survey of eight canned sardine brands
study.method: wet digestion (HNO3/H2SO4/HCl/HClO4) on FOSS Tecator digester, flame AAS (Buck 210)
study.qa: spike recovery described but recoveries not reported; no CRM

findings.group: retail canned sardine brand 1 (code SR), Yenagoa
findings.notes: Triplicate determinations of one can per brand. Zn and Fe magnitudes are far below typical sardine levels (Zn usually above 10 mg/kg); the method weighed "5 ml" of sample, so basis is unclear.

unresolved: The USEPA and WHO limits printed in Table 1 resemble drinking-water values, not fish limits.
Recovery percentages are not reported; the sample amount is given as '5 ml' though it says weighed.
One can per brand; collection dates not reported.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Comparison limits printed in Table 1 labelled USEPA and WHO (mg/kg): Pb 0.015 / 0.01, Cd 0.005 / 0.003, Fe 0.3 / 0.3
